tagline: The card. The number. The miss.
confidence_key: BET = fire a unit. LEAN = half unit or skip if tight. FADE = posted because every game needs a number; would not fire real money.

NFL: A backup safety on the injury report is not a reason to smash the other quarterback.
In a total under 45, take the dog and the running backs before you captain the quarterback.
CFB: A 50-point FCS win is not a license to lay 35-plus the next week.
Fire 6-to-10 point ranked sides in real conference games. Alabama and BYU cashed.
A mid-teens home favorite against a Power opponent can still be a real number. Texas A&M 48-20.
MLB: A plus-money dog still needs the starter to keep it close after three innings.
Confirm the lineup at first pitch. A bat that does not play is a void.

NFL: Do not captain a short-week home favorite just because the name is bigger.
CFB: Do not treat a 50-point FCS win as a repeatable side.
Road 20-plus after a one-score opener is not a lay. Oregon lost 39-31 at Oklahoma State.
A 50-plus number can win the game and miss the spread. Indiana 55-0 missed -57.5.
Road 20-plus against an FBS host can stall. Penn State 27-9 missed -24.5.
A 28-point home favorite with pieces out is not free. Washington 16-14 missed -27.5.
MLB: Do not lay home juice worse than -200.
Do not glue Friday's final onto Saturday's rematch. Yankees cashed Friday and lost 12-2 Saturday.
